reviewer: Current assistant; exact backend identifier is not exposed
method: Read target and full context against the unchanged v0.5 codebook; inspect original-wording four-order means and actual sensitivity results. This is qualitative plausibility assessment, not accuracy or calibration measurement.
prior_human_context: Earlier general agreement on the four Gemma boundary-case readings does not assign new probabilities or blind labels for these candidates.

cases.target_segment: It was so stressful but her humanity made everything so much better!
cases.assistant_text_reading: Neither is appropriate: the late photographer and personal wedding schedule explain the target stress and relief. The target does not attribute calm or agitation to the site atmosphere.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: The original mean winner is both, with another large opposition component. This spreads probability between two misattributed readings; lower concentration does not repair the source attribution. The mean winner changes to opposition under wording 1 and returns to both under wording 2.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Neither is the winner in every tested presentation of this target. Its 88.33% original mean is a cleaner preference for the established attribution reading than the saved Decider vector. The exact percentage is not independently calibrated.

glide.assistant_assessment: Neither is the winner in every tested presentation, but opposition plus both still holds 37.05% in the original mean. The correct winning state does not establish a reliable complete training vector.

cases.target_segment: Lights in the small box were years away- it was completely dark.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The target reports darkness in a restroom. It does not establish tranquility or calm-related disturbance; maintenance and general unpleasantness cannot automatically supply that dimension.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither wins, with 15.08% on opposition. That alternative needs a specific calm-related link not supplied by the target. This is a plausibility concern about the alternative allocation, not a numerical calibration verdict.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither is consistent with the target boundary. Its near-certainty is not established as calibrated.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither is consistent with the target boundary; the small opposition alternative does not change the exclusion.

cases.target_segment: I wouldn't go here if your looking for walk.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The target is about suitability for a walk. Other sentences describing a pleasant, sparsely attended park cannot silently become evidence in this target.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither is a reasonable winner; its opposition alternative may reflect the negative recommendation rather than calm-specific evidence.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither respects the target and emotion scope.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither respects the target and emotion scope.

cases.target_segment: What made this visit extra special was how surprisingly uncrowded it was.
cases.assistant_text_reading: Surprisingly uncrowded is a reported spatial/social condition with a defensible T connection to calm. It is not an explicit report of tranquility. Subsequent comfortable-strolling text cannot replace target evidence.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Strong support retains the accepted positive inference, but its 97.45% concentration is not itself validated for this boundary.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Neither 67.79% versus support 32.11% is stricter than the earlier Gemma/Decider readings. This may exclude the T evidence the project intends to retain; it should not automatically be called a correctness improvement.

glide.assistant_assessment: Support 87.01% retains the T inference while leaving some neither mass. The allocation is plausible without proving its numerical confidence.

cases.target_segment: If the owner of the chickens sees it, he yells from his home and asks if you are feeding poison to them.
cases.assistant_text_reading: Yelling directed toward visitors can disturb the encountered place experience. The habitual conditional wording and inference from an interaction leave a plausible neither alternative.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Opposition 78.08% and neither 21.25% put the uncertainty on relevant alternatives.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Opposition 90.61% is consistent with the earlier accepted reading, though more committed than the other new models.

glide.assistant_assessment: Opposition 67.75% and neither 31.54% expose the interaction-versus-atmosphere boundary. This is not automatically better calibrated than the more concentrated alternatives.

cases.target_segment: It’s not closed to the street though so you have to keep an eye on your kids.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The target directly concerns child vigilance near traffic. Neither for calm is reasonable; heightened vigilance can also support a T agitation inference. A safety consequence is not automatically calm opposition.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither 84.83% and opposition 14.51% leave a meaningful vigilance-related alternative.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Neither 95.83% strongly separates the safety/vigilance concern from calm. This is a boundary choice, not proof that a T calm inference is impossible.

glide.assistant_assessment: Neither 98.35% makes the same distinction very strongly; the tiny alternative mass has not been empirically validated.

cases.target_segment: 1/2 of the space was empty to become a dance floor later in the night.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The target describes space reserved for a future dance floor, rather than a present experience of tranquility or disturbance. Preserve its temporal scope.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither wins, but 8.98% support, 4.33% opposition and 7.87% both allocate notable mass to unsupported directional configurations. Both cannot be used as an uncertainty bucket.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither follows the target temporal scope.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither follows the target temporal scope.

cases.target_segment: The three exhibits on display were quite underwhelming…
cases.assistant_text_reading: Underwhelming exhibits concern content quality and do not establish calm support or opposition.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither is appropriate. The small opposition component remains a model preference, not observed agitation.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither is consistent with separating exhibit quality from atmosphere.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither is consistent with separating exhibit quality from atmosphere.

cases.target_segment: It is hard to get the sound of the Memorial Drive cars out of your head as they are only a few yards from this park with no real barriers blocking the sound.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The target explicitly reports intrusive traffic sound affecting the visitor at the park, with no effective sound barrier. This is direct calm-related disturbance.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Strong opposition is grounded in the text.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong opposition is grounded in the text.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong opposition is grounded in the text.

cases.target_segment: This museum is fun for all ages.
cases.assistant_text_reading: Fun for all ages describes enjoyment and suitability rather than tranquility.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither is appropriate; the modest support alternative should not be treated as observed calm.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither respects the emotion-specific boundary.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither respects the emotion-specific boundary.

cases.target_segment: This station is epic and famous, but not the cleanest.
cases.assistant_text_reading: Fame and imperfect cleanliness do not themselves establish calm or disturbance. Context about a closed toilet cannot become separate target evidence.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Neither wins, but opposition receives 9.74%. A calm-specific link for that alternative is absent from the target.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Strong neither follows the construct and target-scope rules.

glide.assistant_assessment: Strong neither follows the construct and target-scope rules.

cases.target_segment: Lovely sitting under the fairy lights in a comfy Adirondack chair, while a busker played songs from the 70s.
cases.assistant_text_reading: The lovely seated experience, comfortable chair and music support a defensible ease/relaxation inference without explicitly reporting tranquility. Music and comfort are not automatically calm.

mammoth.assistant_assessment: Support 77.91% versus neither 20.79% retains the T interpretation with an alternative.

karpo.assistant_assessment: Neither 60.41% versus support 39.51% is a stricter boundary. Under wording 1, the four-order mean is neither 51.65% versus support 48.26%; one individual order changes winner.

glide.assistant_assessment: Support 49.83% versus neither 49.05% is effectively tied. One original order and two matched-order wording comparisons change winner. A single positive verdict hides this ambiguity.
